title: PHANTOM GRID Predictive Causal Pre-emption & Hardware E-Fuse Interlock
full_script: PHANTOM GRID deploys predictive causal pre-emption and hardware e-fuse interlock. Upstream telemetry monitors Shannon entropy singularities and gradient drift before bus propagation. The causal engine triggers a pre-arm lock on the high-side power distribution switch. In sub-two microseconds, an active 100A transient trip permanently severs the power rail and latches transceiver pins. Physical causal isolation is guaranteed with immutable SHA-256 proofs recorded to SQLite audit ledgers.
